clue.text: Floor rooms — quite a few

parts.note: a flat is a set of rooms to live in
ten is a fair number, quite a few

explanation.surface: Describing a property: a floor of rooms, and quite a lot of them.
explanation.definitionFit: To floor someone or something is to knock it down, to lay it level on the ground.

clue.text: Agent representing female thespian

parts.note: a thespian is an actor

explanation.surface: A theatrical agent represents an actress.
explanation.definitionFit: A factor is an agent who does business on someone else's behalf.

clue.text: Restraint scraps can lack

indicators.note: scraps means throws away, so the can's letters are removed

parts.note: abstinence is restraint from indulgence
a tin is a can

explanation.surface: Self-control throws out what a can might lack.
explanation.walkthrough: 'scraps' looks like a noun but is a verb: take TIN out of ABSTINENCE.
explanation.definitionFit: Absence of something is the lack of it.

clue.text: Bore gave information about time and the ends of time

indicators.note: about means around, so the told piece wraps the rest

parts.note: told means gave information
an era is a period of time

indicators.note: takes the first and last letters of the following word

explanation.surface: A tedious person informed about time and how time ends.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bore' reads as a dull person, but it is the past tense of bear; 'the ends of' takes TE from time.
explanation.definitionFit: Bore, past tense of bear, means put up with, which is to have tolerated it.

clue.text: Still climbing and tearing up — without respite

indicators.note: in a down clue climbing reads upwards, so the word is reversed

parts.note: even can mean still, as in even better
rending is tearing apart

explanation.surface: Still clambering up and ripping things apart, without a break.
explanation.walkthrough: 'climbing' reverses EVEN to NEVE in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Something never-ending goes on without a pause or let-up.

clue.text: Continental is able to, after a short day

indicators.note: after puts the able-to piece behind the short day

parts.note: Fri is the usual short form of Friday
can means is able to

explanation.surface: Someone from mainland Europe manages things once a brief day is over.
explanation.definitionFit: Continental as a noun means a native of a continent, and an African is one such person.

clue.text: A form of the verb ""to be"

definitions.text: A form of the verb ""to be"

parts.words: A form of the verb ""to be"
parts.note: a plain definition read as a grammar lesson: the present plural of the verb

explanation.definitionFit: The word is the present tense plural, as in we or they, of the verb to be.

clue.text: Behind the times, firm's head is dismissed

indicators.note: the head of the word, its first letter, is removed

parts.note: trusty means firm and reliable

explanation.surface: An old-fashioned company sacks its boss.
explanation.walkthrough: 'head is dismissed' removes T from TRUSTY.
explanation.definitionFit: Rusty means out of practice or out of date, behind the times.

clue.text: Pirate, has taken over half of island, look!

indicators.note: half of means only the first part of the island's name is kept

parts.note: Corsica is a Mediterranean island
an air is a look or manner

explanation.surface: A pirate seizes half an island; behold!
explanation.definitionFit: A corsair was a pirate, especially of the Barbary coast.

clue.text: Capital we held in another form

indicators.note: putting letters into another form rearranges them

explanation.surface: A capital city we once held, now changed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in another form' — the 'in' is fodder: WEHELDIN is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: New Delhi is the capital city of India.

clue.text: Celia's TV flickering at start of evening's That's Life

indicators.note: a flickering picture shifts about, so these letters are jumbled
takes only the opening letter of the next word

explanation.surface: Celia's television flickers as the evening's episode of a TV show begins.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flickering' scrambles CELIASTV (the S of Celia's counts here); 'at start of' takes E from evening's, giving the French phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: The French phrase is the shrugging idiom meaning such is life, which is what the English phrase says.

clue.text: Pale yellow growths, unwanted, rejected

indicators.note: rejected means sent back, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: warts are unwanted growths on the skin

explanation.surface: Pallid yellowish lumps that nobody wants are thrown out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rejected' turns WARTS round.
explanation.definitionFit: Straw is the colour name for a pale yellow like dried stalks of corn.

clue.text: He has a point — individual's right to admit hat

annotationWithheld.why: He has a point — individual's right to admit hat: ONE + R admitting W (a point) gives OWNER defined by 'He has', but 'hat' as printed has no job; the clue likely meant 'that'
annotationWithheld.clue: He has a point — individual's right to admit hat

clue.text: Previously prepared to study, boy and girl pulled back

parts.note: to read a subject is to study it

indicators.note: pulled back means drawn in reverse, so the pair is read backwards

parts.note: Ed is a boy's name
Amy is a girl's name

explanation.surface: Getting ready to study while a boy and a girl are hauled back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pulled back' reverses EDAMY to YMADE.
explanation.definitionFit: Something ready-made was made beforehand, so it comes already prepared.

clue.text: What sounds like high five given during a Bond exploit

indicators.note: given during puts the spoken piece inside the other letters

parts.note: cement is a bond or binding agent

indicators.note: says the next words are taken as they sound when spoken

parts.note: high five, said as 'hi' plus the letter V

explanation.surface: A celebratory high five during a James Bond adventure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bond' reads as the spy, but it is a binding agent; the high five is not a gesture but two spoken sounds, a greeting and a Roman numeral.
explanation.definitionFit: An exploit is a bold deed, and an achievement is something done successfully.

clue.text: Cooking the lunch, trifle is ditched

indicators.note: cooking means fiddling or rearranging, as in cooking the books

explanation.surface: While the lunch is being cooked, the trifle is thrown away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cooking' scrambles THELUNCH and TRIFLE together.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means abandoned in a difficult spot, much as being ditched does.

clue.text: Fall in love, but become discouraged

definitions.meaning: to lose one's heart to someone is to fall in love
to lose courage and give up hope

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both giving one's heart away in love and losing courage.

clue.text: If necessary, move slowly after, a knock

indicators.note: after puts the slow move behind the knock

parts.note: a tap is a light knock
to inch is to move slowly

explanation.surface: If needed, creep along after a rap at the door.
explanation.definitionFit: At a pinch is an idiom for if absolutely necessary.

clue.text: Solid has this diminished, torn off

indicators.note: off means gone bad or out of order, so these letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A solid object reduced and ripped apart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off' scrambles DIMINISHED and TORN; 'torn' is fodder, not the signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A solid object has depth as well as length and breadth, which is its extra dimension.

clue.text: Fiery soldier's upset -no use being upset

indicators.note: in a down clue upset means turned upside down, so the letters read upwards

parts.note: a GI is an American soldier

indicators.note: being upset means knocked over and disordered, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A hot-tempered soldier is upset; there is no point being upset.
explanation.walkthrough: The first 'upset' reverses GI to IG; 'being upset' scrambles NOUSE to NEOUS.
explanation.definitionFit: Igneous rock is formed from fire-hot molten magma, so the word means of fire.

clue.text: Working without computer to reproduce old letter

indicators.note: without means outside, so the working word goes around the other

parts.note: on means working, as a machine is on
a micro is a microcomputer

explanation.surface: Working without a computer to copy out an ancient letter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' here means outside, not lacking.
explanation.definitionFit: Omicron is a letter of the ancient Greek alphabet.

clue.text: Holiday following one in France is ace

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
est is French for is
A is the abbreviation for ace on playing cards

explanation.surface: A holiday comes after someone in France scores an ace.
explanation.definitionFit: A fiesta is a festive holiday, especially in Spanish-speaking countries.

clue.text: Star writer with time to fish

parts.note: a pen is something that writes
to angle is to fish with rod and line

explanation.surface: A famous author takes some time off to go fishing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Star' reads as a celebrity, but it is the shape.
explanation.definitionFit: A pentangle is a five-pointed star figure.

clue.text: Region accommodating original naumachia, for instance

definitions.text: Region accommodating original naumachia, for instance

indicators.note: accommodating means holding inside

parts.note: an area is a region

indicators.note: original means the first letter of the next word

explanation.surface: A space that once held staged sea battles.
explanation.walkthrough: A naumachia was a mock sea battle staged in a flooded Roman arena, so the whole clue describes one.
explanation.definitionFit: An arena is an enclosed region for spectacles, such as the flooded Roman shows called naumachia.

clue.text: Island 26 — it's in the middle of the road

parts.note: 26 across is husband, and H is its abbreviation

indicators.note: in the middle of puts the pronoun inside the road

parts.note: the A1 is Britain's longest numbered road, written AI in crosswords
taken as written

explanation.surface: An island stands in the middle of a road, like a traffic island.
explanation.walkthrough: The A1 is the main road from London to Edinburgh; 1 is read as the letter I.
explanation.definitionFit: Haiti is a Caribbean country occupying part of an island.

clue.text: Nobody's taking drug, after midday

indicators.note: after puts the drug behind midday

parts.note: noon is midday
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: Nobody takes drugs in the afternoon.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of Nobody's stands for 'is', so the definition reads 'Nobody is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Nobody and the two-word phrase are exact synonyms for not a single person.

clue.text: So Rebecca's son and daughter finally entered lists?

indicators.note: entered means went inside, so these letters go within the other word

parts.note: thus means so, in that way
in Genesis, Esau is a son of Rebecca and Isaac

indicators.note: takes only the closing letter of daughter

explanation.surface: A biblical son and daughter finally sign up on some lists.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags a definition by example: a thesaurus is a book of word lists.
explanation.definitionFit: A thesaurus is a reference book made up of lists of synonyms.

clue.text: Chap finishing third of 3

indicators.note: takes the last third of the word given by the cross-reference

parts.note: 3 down is tolerated

explanation.surface: A man ends up third out of three.
explanation.walkthrough: Clue 3 down has nine letters; its final third is three letters long.
explanation.definitionFit: Ted is a man's name, and a chap is a man.

clue.text: Conserve the better half

definitions.meaning: to ... resources is to use them sparingly, to save
one's better half is a jocular name for a spouse

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to manage thriftily; as a noun it is a spouse, jokingly called a better half.

clue.text: Giant —- one accompanying a queen

parts.note: a titan is a giant
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A giant and a companion escort a queen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'accompanying' only joins the pieces side by side.
explanation.definitionFit: Titania is queen of the fairies in Shakespeare's A Midsummer Night's Dream.
